DataSource.query:
select max(anzahl)
from
(
select stichtag,max(anzahl) as anzahl
from
(
select to_char(stichtag,'DD.MM.YYYY') as stichtag,count(stichtag) as anzahl from stg_ifrs_grunddaten where  stg_ifrs_grunddaten.herkunft_anlief_kennzahl ='APPIAN' group by stichtag
union all
select to_char(stichtag,'DD.MM.YYYY') as stichtag,count(stichtag) as anzahl from stg_ifrs_grunddaten where  stg_ifrs_grunddaten.herkunft_anlief_kennzahl ='ACCOUNTING'  group by stichtag
)
group by stichtag
)
